lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Four hours up the valley road on foot, past the last of the perimeter lighting. The monastery is a low stone building with a light on in it, which at this hour in this century is close to a miracle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A woman in a habit is standing in the doorway with her arms folded, as though she has been expecting somebody for some time and is not fussy about who.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You walked up. Nobody walks up. The road is four hours and there has not been a reason to be on it since the ferry stopped.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Come inside before you are a silhouette on a road.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I know you are the sort of trouble that arrives on foot at four in the morning, which narrows it considerably. I will learn the rest inside.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: There is a man in the kitchen who is going to be extremely rude to you within about a minute of meeting you. He is worth listening to anyway. Most rude people are not. He is.
